description: This Python script sets up a test server supporting HTTP, TCP proxy, WebSocket, and basic auth proxy functionalities for Chrome testing. It includes server classes, request handlers, and server configuration options.

classes.name: WebSocketOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for the WebSocket server, including host, port, security, and authentication settings.

classes.name: ThreadingHTTPServer
classes.description: A specialized HTTP server that creates a new thread for each connection and includes client verification.

classes.name: TestPageHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests for testing, providing default responses and handling CONNECT requests.

classes.name: ProxyRequestHandler
classes.description: Implements a proxy server handling CONNECT, GET, and HEAD methods, with support for connection forwarding.

classes.name: BasicAuthProxyRequestHandler
classes.description: A proxy handler requiring basic authentication for requests.

methods.name: DefaultResponseHandler
methods.description: Handles default HTTP responses for unhandled requests.

methods.name: DefaultConnectResponseHandler
methods.description: Handles default responses for malformed or illegal CONNECT requests.

methods.name: _start_read_write
methods.description: Facilitates bidirectional data transfer between client and server sockets.

methods.name: do_CONNECT
methods.description: Handles HTTP CONNECT method to establish a TCP tunnel.

methods.name: do_GET
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests by forwarding to common method.

methods.name: do_HEAD
methods.description: Handles HTTP HEAD requests by forwarding to common method.

methods.name: parse_request
methods.description: Overrides request parsing to include basic authentication validation.

methods.name: create_server
methods.description: Creates and configures the appropriate server instance based on options.

methods.name: add_options
methods.description: Adds command-line options for server configuration.
